title: Liveness: detect nod, turn and look up/down challenges

requirements.expectation: headPose returns yaw for a left/right turn and pitch for a nod, ignores roll, separates combined rotations, and gives the same magnitudes for a row-major layout or a flipped forward axis.
requirements.verification: Unit tests with constructed rotation matrices.
evidence: code: src/components/profile/face-liveness/__tests__/head-pose.test.ts (7 headPose cases). Under the previous formulas the turn, nod and roll cases would fail: turn gave yaw 0, nod gave pitch 0, roll was read as yaw.

requirements.expectation: Yaw and pitch ranges are measured over the last 1.5 s of frames, not the last 18, so a slow nod on a 15 fps phone still registers.
requirements.verification: Unit tests of pushTimed/timedRange; code inspection of detection-tick.ts.
evidence: code: head-pose.test.ts 'keeps a slow nod inside the window' and 'drops samples older than the window'. detection-tick.ts uses pushTimed/timedRange for yaw and pitch.

requirements.expectation: turn_left passes only when the person turns to their own left (nose toward the image's right in the raw frame) and turn_right only to their right, each needing |yaw| > 0.18.
requirements.verification: Unit tests of headTurnSide; code inspection of detection-tick.ts.
evidence: code: head-pose.test.ts 'headTurnSide' (left positive, right negative, edge order independent, missing landmarks).

requirements.expectation: look_up and look_down are measured from the person's own recent position with landmarks (not against the camera's level), so a slight tilt up from a head already tilted down passes. Nod also accepts the landmark tilt range. The prompts read 'Tilt your head up/down'.
requirements.verification: Unit tests of headTiltRatio/timedExtent; code inspection.
evidence: code: head-pose.test.ts 'headTiltRatio' including 'counts a small tilt up from a head already tilted down (phone held low)'.

requirements.expectation: lint has 0 errors; typecheck and the full test suite pass; files stay at or under 300 lines.
requirements.verification: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test.
evidence: code: 2026-11-23, uncommitted tree. lint: 0 errors, 141 warnings (none new). typecheck clean. test: 289 files, 2885 tests passed (16 in head-pose.test.ts). helpers.ts 152, detection-tick.ts 273, use-face-liveness.ts 282 lines.

requirements.expectation: On a phone, each challenge registers in one natural movement in the right direction only (turn left/right, tilt up/down, nod), and a three-challenge session completes without lockout.
requirements.verification: Manual device check on the dev deployment.

code: Independent review of the reviewed commit.
Tune TURN_SIDE_MIN / TILT_MIN from device results.
